notes: Bitcoin consensus constants used by sim/consensus.gd. These are protocol facts, not tuning, so they live here with sources instead of in data/tuning. Validate with tools/check_tuning.py.

initial_subsidy_sats.note: 50 BTC per block at launch (50 * COIN).

subsidy_shift_limit.note: Bitcoin Core forces the subsidy to zero once the right shift reaches 64.

max_retarget_factor.note: The measured timespan is clamped to a quarter and four times the target, so difficulty moves at most 4x either way per retarget.

min_difficulty.note: powLimit. Difficulty can never fall below 1.

hashes_per_difficulty_1.note: 2^32, the convention btc_daily.csv uses to estimate hashrate. The exact expected value is 2^48 / 65,535, which is 0.0015% higher; using the same constant as the dataset keeps player and world hashrate on one scale.
